records.title: Electronic Committee Management System (ECMS).
records.summary: Caerphilly County Borough Council invites tenders for the provision, implementation, support and maintenance of a comprehensive Electronic Committee Management System (ECMS).
records.description:
Caerphilly County Borough Council invites tenders for the provision, implementation, support and maintenance of a comprehensive Electronic Committee Management System (ECMS).
The Council requires a modern, secure, cloud-hosted solution to support the administration and governance of democratic services and committee management activities. The solution must facilitate the efficient creation, management, publication and archiving of committee agendas, reports, minutes, decisions and associated meeting documentation.
The Council requires a fully bilingual (English and Welsh) system that supports the needs of elected Members, officers and the public whilst ensuring compliance with Welsh Language Standards, accessibility requirements, data protection legislation and recognised security standards.
The solution should provide functionality including, but not limited to:
•	Committee, meeting and calendar management.
•	Agenda, report and minutes production workflows.
•	Decision and action tracking.
•	Public-facing committee information and publication portal.
•	Secure Member and officer access via desktop, tablet and mobile devices.
•	Bilingual content management and publication.
•	Electronic distribution of meeting papers.
•	Meeting attendance and voting management.
•	Document storage, search and retrieval functionality.
•	Integration with Microsoft 365 and other relevant Council systems.
•	Role-based access controls and audit reporting.
•	Management information and performance reporting.
The successful supplier will be responsible for:
•	Solution provisioning and implementation.
•	System configuration and data migration where required.
•	User acceptance testing support.
•	Training for system administrators, officers and elected Members.
•	Ongoing software maintenance, upgrades and technical support.
Full details can be found in the ITT (Tender Pack)

records.description:
The Home Office is conducting a mini-competition via the GCA's Quality Assurance & Testing for IT Systems 2 DPS, RM6148.

The outcome of the tender shall see the Home Office award 2 Call-Off Contracts to two different suppliers to provide quality assurance, quality engineering and testing services for applications and systems across the Home Office. 

Each contract will support a distinct set of service areas/portfolios within the Home Office, and shall include the provision of resource augmentation and managed services.

Each contract will have a maximum value of £150m with an initial duration of 3 years, and a further extension option of 1-year.

The contract value does not indicate a level of committed spend, as all services shall be commissioned via Statements of Work under the contract, setting our deliverables, team profiles, and the applicable charging/payment method. 

For instructions on how to access the tender documents, please refer to the Joining Instructions that are attached to this Notice.
